title: the Marlowe Estate Rising Revisited
author: Tamsin Nakamura
blurb: Ines Sandoval, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
